events.title: AAHAR · The International Food & Hospitality Fair
events.short_desc: India’s flagship food and hospitality convention. Over 1,800 hospitality procurement directors and cloud kitchen operators visited the Ace Packaging pavilion to experience our airtight gravy tubs and multi-cavity bento trays.
events.full_desc:
Organized by the India Trade Promotion Organisation (ITPO), AAHAR is the epicenter of India’s culinary, catering, and institutional hospitality sector.

Ace Packaging showcased the complete 100+ model product line, with live food service simulations demonstrating how our containers maintain food presentation during heavy-duty bike courier transit.

The showcase resulted in over 45 long-term corporate supply partnerships across leading QSR franchises, cloud kitchen networks, and sweets manufacturers in North and West India.
events.gallery: ["Over 1,200 physical sample kits delivered to restaurant chains and QSRs","In-person rim seal drop testing demonstrating zero leakage during transit","Signed supply commitments across 40+ premier QSR dining brands","Showcased one-piece hinge sauce cups with attached leak-proof lids"]
